ownership.parent: Anexia (Anexia Internetdienstleistungs GmbH / Anexia Holding GmbH, Klagenfurt, Austria)
ownership.quote: netcup was founded as a one-man business by Felix Preuss and was merged to netcup GmbH in 2008, where he has been CEO until 2020. Since 2016, netcup - today managed by Alexander Windbichler and Oliver Werner - is part of the Anexia group.

stage.quote: Since 2016, netcup - today managed by Alexander Windbichler and Oliver Werner - is part of the Anexia group.
stage.note: netcup has never disclosed any VC/equity fundraising; it was a bootstrapped one-man business (founded by Felix Preuss) that incorporated as a GmbH in 2008, then in 2016 became part of Anexia, itself a founder-owned (Alexander Windbichler), bootstrapped Austrian cloud/ISP group founded in 2006 with no reported external funding rounds. No priced VC round found for either netcup or Anexia, so 'subsidiary' is used instead of a funding stage.

note: netcup GmbH is a German (Karlsruhe/Nuremberg) VPS/root-server/web-hosting provider, founded as a one-man business by Felix Preuss and incorporated as netcup GmbH in 2008. Since November 2016 it has been part of the Anexia group, an Austrian cloud/ISP group (founded 2006 in Klagenfurt by Alexander Windbichler) that is itself privately/founder-owned with no reported VC funding. No Y Combinator or other accelerator affiliation found. No evidence of any priced equity funding round for netcup or Anexia; both present themselves as an established, profitable, independently (non-VC) financed group, so funding/stage fields are recorded as unknown/subsidiary rather than guessed.
